title: Country Case — Saudi Arabia Regulatory Demand Context

text.content: ZATCA Phase 1 requires electronic generation and storage of tax invoices; Phase 2 requires integration of taxpayer e-invoicing solutions with ZATCA/Fatoora and is rolled out in waves. ZATCA's 2026 Wave 25 announcement targets taxpayers above the stated SAR 187,500 VAT-revenue threshold in the specified prior years for integration by February 1, 2027.
